name: The Marketing Therapy Offer Studio
author: The Marketing Therapy

sections.description:
Offer Studio helps you create automatic discounts for your WooCommerce store. The Free plugin works independently and does not require a paid account or a trial.

Free features:
* Percentage discounts on eligible products.
* A fixed amount off each eligible item.
* A fixed discount distributed across eligible cart items.
* Target all products, selected products or selected categories.
* Start and end dates in the store timezone.
* Sale-product exclusions, discount caps and coupon-combination settings.
* Activation coupon codes and first/returning signed-in customer targeting.
* Offer priority, paused copies and a global pause switch.
* An offer check and a calculation test before enabling a campaign.

One qualifying product offer applies at a time. Lower priority numbers run first. Catalog prices are not overwritten, and editing a campaign does not change historical orders. WooCommerce calculates taxes and native coupons.

Separate Pro extension

The separately distributed Offer Studio Pro extension adds buy-one-get-one offers, second-item discounts, quantity levels, bundles, automatic gifts, shipping campaigns, visual badges, progress bars and campaign reports. Free discounts remain available without Pro.

Pro is installed separately and requires its own license or trial. Free features do not expire and do not require a license.

Compatibility and scope

WooCommerce is required. Local automated checks use WooCommerce 11.2.1 and WordPress 7.1.4. Wider version and third-party compatibility validation is still in progress.

Whole-number product quantities are supported. The discount engine starts from native catalog prices; compatibility with other dynamic-pricing, product add-on or multi-currency extensions is not claimed.

Privacy

The Free plugin does not connect to an external licensing or analytics service. Opening an optional Pro trial link takes you to the separate Freemius checkout, where its terms and privacy information apply. Offer configuration is stored in the site’s WordPress options. Applied offer details are recorded in WooCommerce order item metadata. It does not add an external tracking service.

Source code

All PHP, JavaScript and CSS sources are included in this package. assets/admin.js is the directly maintained, readable JavaScript source; no compilation, bundling or minification is required to run or modify it. No external build service is needed.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Install and activate Offer Studio Free.
  3. Open WooCommerce > Offer Studio > New offer.
  4. Choose a type, set products and conditions, and test the calculation.
  5. Save the offer. Enable it explicitly when you are ready.
sections.faq:
Does Free require an account or subscription?

No. The Free discount features work without an external account or paid license.

Can offers stack?

One qualifying product campaign wins by priority. Other coupons prevent the campaign unless you explicitly allow them. Pro shipping campaigns are evaluated separately per shipping package.

Does the plugin change product prices permanently?

No. It adjusts eligible cart line prices. Catalog prices and historical order snapshots are preserved.

Does the calculation test place an order?

No. It is a simulation. Stock, scheduling, customer conditions, coupons, taxes and shipping must also be checked in the real cart.

What happens if Pro is deactivated?

Free discount types remain available. Pro campaign types cannot apply without the separate extension. Pro gift lines are removed when the cart is recalculated with Free only.

0.3.1

  • Refreshed the admin interface with consistent Marketing Therapy colors, clearer forms, buttons and responsive layouts.

0.3.0

  • Use a unique namespace and prefixes throughout Free and Pro.
  • Preserve earlier settings, saved designs and historical reporting during upgrade.
  • Escape badge HTML at output and correct the author website URL.

0.2.9

  • Make activation coupon codes and customer audience targeting fully available in Free.
  • Sanitize extension input before save and preview filters.
  • Provide readable JavaScript source and document the source layout.

0.2.8

  • Refresh the shared Free and Pro admin interface with Marketing Therapy branding, compact navigation and clearer form styling.
  • Preserve campaign rules, calculations and storefront designs.

0.2.7

  • Align the plugin name with the publisher identity.
  • Correct the asset version used for cache invalidation.
  • Prepare a separate WordPress.org package using community language packs.

0.2.6

  • Keep disabled field arrows aligned without repeated background images.
  • Include current publication screenshot captions.

0.2.5

  • Add a separate single-site monthly option with a first-payment introductory discount.
  • Preserve annual packages and the seven-day annual trial; annual subscriptions remain separate.

0.2.4

  • Keep spend-gift product selectors inside the designer on tablet screens.
  • Align spend-gift amounts, products and removal controls across screen sizes.
  • Keep combination summaries concise and omit empty suggestion pickers.

0.2.3

  • Use language-specific singular and plural forms for stock gift progress messages.
  • Preserve personal progress messages.

0.2.2

  • Keep the selected offer type in new-form design previews.
  • Use type-specific badge and progress templates when the saved variant is empty.

0.2.1

  • Release candidate with current license/trial integration and compact visual designers.
  • Preserve independent Free features and saved campaigns when Pro is inactive.

0.2.0

  • Development build with guided offer creation, global settings, calculation checks and Greek translations.
  • Independent Free and Pro packages.
